name: exposed_record
description: In main.go, `suspendSupplier` updates `supplier.s_status` to `'suspended'`, but `listProducts` queries `product` joined to `supplier` without filtering supplier status (e.g. no `WHERE s.s_status != 'suspended'`). This matches the exposed-record signal because products from suspended suppliers are still returned by the read endpoint as purchasable/visible.
